name: wanshang-ai
description: 腕上AI —— 小米 Vela 手表上的 AI 助手快应用，支持 DeepSeek 官方接口与自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点、联网搜索、模型切换

scripts.release: npm run release:rw5 && npm run release:s5 && npm run release:bandpro
scripts.release:rw5: WANSHANG_TARGET=rw5 aiot release --enable-jsc && node scripts/verify-rpk-signature.js --allow-missing && node scripts/collect-rpk.js rw5-rw6
scripts.release:s5: WANSHANG_TARGET=s5 aiot release --enable-jsc && node scripts/verify-rpk-signature.js --allow-missing && node scripts/collect-rpk.js s5
scripts.release:bandpro: WANSHANG_TARGET=bandpro aiot release --enable-jsc && node scripts/verify-rpk-signature.js --allow-missing && node scripts/collect-rpk.js band9p-10p
